channel.title: Kronos Fusion Energy — News
channel.description: News and dated research results from Kronos Fusion Energy, a family-owned American fusion company — each item linked to its published record. Breeder and generator physics, in the open.

item.title: Dr. Carl Weggel joins as Founding Partner and Chief Scientist
item.description: Dr. Carl Weggel joined Kronos in 2022 as a Founding Partner and Chief Scientist, leading the company's S.M.A.R.T. magnet-design effort.

item.title: The Next Gate: From Simulation to Hardware
item.description: Most of what Kronos has closed so far lives in simulation and analysis: the digital twin, gyrokinetic transport runs, and structural and neutronic models built against the frozen breeder and burner design points.

item.title: Recompute it yourself: Kronos validators go live in the browser
item.description: Kronos took the claims underlying the De-risking Register and made each one a live, browser-based validator — a card that recomputes the claim from its stated inputs, in front of the reader.

item.title: Design locked: center-stack shielding geometry
item.description: Design lock: the shield geometry wrapped around the breeder's centrepost — the column carrying 16.84 T at the frozen design point — is now locked to a reference layout.

item.title: Burner design-point dataset posted for independent reproduction
item.description: The Aegis/MetroVolt D–³He burner design point is now a citable dataset built for independent reproduction.

item.title: Structural: the vacuum vessel's 1-D thermal profile
item.description: The vacuum vessel sits between two very different thermal environments — a magnet set held near 20 K, REBCO tape's operating point, on one side, and a burning plasma radiating heat on the other.

item.title: Gate closed: centrepost structural margin passes at 181 MPa
item.description: Gate closed: centrepost structural margin passes.

item.title: Centrepost Stress Passes With Margin at 181 MPa
item.description: The centrepost carries the toroidal-field return current through the machine's narrowest cross-section — the column most exposed to combined electromagnetic and thermal load.

item.title: Burner Design Point Published: The D–³He Tandem-Mirror Reference Case
item.description: The companion reference case for the burner line - the low-neutron D-He3 tandem mirror shared by Aegis and MetroVolt - is now public.

item.title: Priyanca Ford founds Kronos Fusion Energy
item.description: Kronos Fusion Energy was founded in 2022 by Priyanca Ford, Founder and CEO, who publishes technical work as P. I. Ford. The founding thesis is simple and unchanged: build the spherical-tokamak breeder platform first — tritium, helium-3, and neutron services — and let net electric power follow as a later product line, n…

item.title: Kronos Enters Pre-Commercial Validation
item.description: Kronos has entered pre-commercial validation — the stage between a frozen design and a construction start.

item.title: The physics engine is open: Kronos releases its research toolkit
item.description: The same physics engine Kronos uses internally to derive its frozen design points is now public: github.com/KronosFE/kronos-toolkit.

item.title: Design locked: the 20 K cryogenic network, closed-cycle
item.description: Design lock: Kronos has frozen the cryogenic architecture that keeps the breeder's REBCO coils superconducting — a closed-cycle network holding the magnet set near 20 K.

item.title: Breeder design-point dataset live on Zenodo
item.description: The Hyperion breeder's frozen design point is not just a line in a paper — it's a versioned Zenodo deposit you can pull and re-run.

item.title: Transport: the nonlinear core-turbulence run behind negative triangularity
item.description: The negative-triangularity shaping behind the breeder's frozen design point — δ = −0.30 — is a physics claim, and physics claims need a code that resolves turbulence nonlinearly to check them, not just a linear stability estimate.

item.title: Gate closed: net tritium breeding clears self-sufficiency
item.description: Gate closed: net tritium breeding clears self-sufficiency in the Hyperion breeder platform.

item.title: Net Tritium Breeding Confirmed Self-Sufficient — TBR ≥ 1.05
item.description: Tritium self-sufficiency comes down to one ratio: local production over consumption across the blanket volume, TBR = (∫_V Σ_T φ dV) / R_fus.

item.title: Breeder Design Point Published: Hyperion's Q = 3.076 Reference Case
item.description: The frozen breeder reference case for Hyperion, our spherical-tokamak platform, is now public and re-runnable.

item.title: The Horizon: Toward Gate-Stage Hardware
item.description: As 2026 closes, Kronos looks ahead to its gated program — engaging vendors and the supply chain on the path from a validated design toward first hardware.

item.title: Load-Following Capability Modeled for Grid Integration
item.description: Kronos models load-following capability for grid integration in its design point, ahead of the gated program.

item.title: Microsecond AI Control Modeled for Vertical Displacement Events
item.description: Simulations show the microsecond AI digital twin can mitigate vertical displacement events (VDEs) in the design.

item.title: Center-Stack Neutron Shield and Fluence Budget Analyzed
item.description: 2026 simulation campaigns analyze the shielded center-stack neutron-fluence budget for the low-neutron design — no breeding blanket required.

item.title: The 20 K Closed-Cycle Cryogenic Network Design Locked
item.description: Kronos locks the design of its 20 K closed-cycle cryogenic network, eliminating liquid-helium infrastructure from the balance-of-plant.

item.title: 1-D Thermal Gradient and Vacuum Vessel Structural Analysis Published
item.description: Kronos publishes its 1-D thermal-gradient (1700 C plasma edge) data and full vacuum-vessel structural analysis.

item.title: The 2026 Tech Audit Presentation Delivered
item.description: Kronos delivers its 2026 Tech Audit - a full disclosure of generator physics and engineering.

item.title: Entering the Pre-Commercial Validation Stage
item.description: Kronos transitions out of conceptual R&D into the pre-commercial validation stage for the S.M.A.R.T. generator family.

item.title: The Autonomous AI Stability System Detailed
item.description: Kronos details the design of its autonomous AI stability ('immune') system for real-time plasma control.

item.title: The Staged Fuel Cycle Strategy Solidified
item.description: Kronos solidifies its staged fuel-cycle strategy, bridging near-term commissioning toward low-neutron D-3He operation.

item.title: Expansion of the Simulation Suite to 12 Modules
item.description: The Kronos AI simulation suite expands to twelve interoperable modules spanning magnets, plasma, and balance-of-plant.

item.title: Channel 3 & 4: Thermionic and Photovoltaic Energy Capture
item.description: DEC Channels 3 and 4 - thermionic emission and photovoltaic capture - finalize designs to harvest surface heat and radiation.

item.title: Channel 1 & 2: Electrostatic and MHD Extraction Maturation
item.description: DEC Channels 1 and 2 - electrostatic retarding-field and MHD extraction - mature through 2025 engineering.

item.title: The 5-Channel Direct Energy Conversion (DEC) Blueprint
item.description: Kronos publishes the complete engineering blueprint for its 5-channel Direct Energy Conversion system.

item.title: The AEGIS System for Modular Defense Applications
item.description: Kronos unveils AEGIS, a hardened, modular generator line for defense, remote, and critical-infrastructure missions.

item.title: Formal Introduction of the MetroVolt Urban Generator
item.description: Kronos formally introduces MetroVolt, its commercial urban fusion generator.

item.title: Priyanca Ford's Q1 Founder Update
item.description: Founder Priyanca Ford's Q1 update on the company's long-run ambitions and program direction.

item.title: Simulation Validates Negative Triangularity Plasma Shaping
item.description: Kronos's simulation suite validates negative-triangularity plasma shaping for the S.M.A.R.T. reactor - suppressing edge instabilities without H-mode.

item.title: Jack Dongarra Optimizes Exascale Computing Workflows
item.description: Turing Award winner Jack Dongarra advises on optimizing the exascale computing workflows behind the digital twin.

item.title: Sushma Bhatia Steers Legislative and Environmental Strategy
item.description: Advisory board member Sushma Bhatia steers the company's legislative and environmental strategy.

item.title: Ruben Fair's Expertise Applied to Magnetic Shielding
item.description: Board advisor Ruben Fair brings three decades of magnet-design and magnetic-shielding expertise to the program.

item.title: Dr. Gerald Kulcinski Champions the Aneutronic Vision
item.description: Fusion pioneer Dr. Gerald Kulcinski joins the podcast, validating the low-neutron D-3He pathway and its aneutronic p-11B endpoint.

item.title: "The Kronos Fusion Energy Podcast" Expands Educational Reach
item.description: 'The Kronos Fusion Energy Podcast,' hosted by Priyanca Ford, expands to demystify fusion and engage tier-one talent.

item.title: Synergies with MagLab Enhance High-Temperature Superconductors
item.description: Work at the National High Magnetic Field Laboratory advances characterization of the high-temperature superconducting (REBCO) tapes central to the magnet system.

item.title: World's First Component Factory Established in India
item.description: Kronos establishes its first Fusion Energy Component Factory in India, executing on international scaling.

item.title: Jon Michel Greenwood Spearheads Digital Twin Architecture
item.description: CTO Jon Michel Greenwood elevates the Kronos simulation suite into a fully realized digital-twin platform.

item.title: Global Call for Supply Chain Partnerships
item.description: Kronos launches a Supply Chain Partnership Portal, marking the transition from design toward manufacturing readiness.

item.title: Establishing the KFEDS Defense Security Posture
item.description: Kronos formalizes the KFEDS defense security posture, highlighting the resilience advantages of compact fusion for critical infrastructure.

item.title: PUZZLE X 2023: The Helium-3 Dawn Presented
item.description: Founder Priyanca Ford delivers the keynote 'From Star Power to Earth: Helium-3 & the Dawn of the Fusion Era' at PUZZLE X in Barcelona.

item.title: Alignment with the DOE Milestone-Based Fusion Program
item.description: Kronos aligns its development plan with the U.S. Department of Energy's Milestone-Based Fusion Development Program.

item.title: Global Community Invited to Beta Test Algorithms
item.description: In an unusual move for a private fusion developer, Kronos opens its simulation suite to a global community of beta testers.

item.title: Unveiling of the AI/ML-Powered Simulation Suite
item.description: Kronos unveils its AI/ML-powered simulation suite - the computational backbone that would grow into the company's digital twin.

item.title: Paul Weiss Elevated to Lead Material Sciences & Nano Technology
item.description: Dr. Paul Weiss, holder of the Fred Kavli Chair in NanoSystems Sciences, formally takes the helm of Material Sciences & Nano Technology.

item.title: Staged Fuel-Cycle Strategy Initiated
item.description: Kronos launches its staged fuel-cycle strategy — bridging a brief deuterium–tritium commissioning stage toward low-neutron deuterium–helium-3 operation, with helium-3 bred in situ via catalyzed D–D (no breeding blanket).
